question: What is the e-DPC Portal?
answer: The e-DPC Portal of the Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission runs the Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) process online: the department prepares the Pre-DPC and DPC proposal, the Commission conducts the sitting, and the result and promotion list are digitally signed.

question: Who uses the e-DPC Portal?
answer: Department Admin (allots the AO and AH), Authorized Officer (AO, enters the data and submits), Administrative Head (AH, reviews, approves and signs), the CGPSC Chairman and Members (allotment, sitting and result), the CGPSC Administrator, and Promotion Candidates (see their own DPC and result).
variants: What are the roles in the portal?

question: How do I log in?
answer: Open the portal and choose Login. Enter your email address, mobile number or employee number, and your password. On first login with a temporary password you must change it before continuing.
variants: How do I login to the DPC portal?

question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
answer: On the login page choose Forgot Password, enter your registered email or mobile number, enter the OTPs sent to you, and set a new password.
variants: How do I reset my password?

question: What is the step-by-step DPC process?
answer: 1. The Department Admin creates the Pre-DPC and allots the AO and AH. 2. The AO fills and submits the Pre-DPC; the AH approves it. 3. The AO creates the DPC proposal, completes every section and submits it. 4. The AH approves, signs and forwards it to CGPSC. 5. CGPSC allots it to a Member, who conducts the sitting and approves the result. 6. The AH issues the promotion order. 7. The AO marks the DPC Proceeding Complete.

question: How do I know what to do next?
answer: After each step the portal shows a pop-up telling you what to do next, and the next section or button is marked with a green Next step flag. If the next step belongs to someone else, the pop-up names who it is waiting with.

question: Why can I not see a Pre-DPC or DPC?
answer: You see a Pre-DPC or DPC only when the Department Admin has allotted it to you as its AO or AH. Ask your Department Admin to check the allotment.

question: Can I edit a proposal after submitting it?
answer: Not directly; a submitted proposal is read-only. The AH can return it to you for correction. Until the CGPSC result, the AO can also recall a Submitted or Approved DPC: it goes back to Returned, the AO corrects and re-submits, and the AH approves it again.
variants: How do I correct a submitted DPC?

question: Why are my saved form fields locked?
answer: After you save a section its fields are locked so they are not changed by mistake. Click Edit on that section to change them again, then Save.
variants: How do I change saved data?

question: How is the retirement date calculated?
answer: If the date of birth is the 1st of a month, the officer retires on the last day of the previous month. Otherwise the officer retires on the last day of the month of birth.
variants: How does the portal calculate superannuation date?

question: How is the average CR grade worked out?
answer: When the average of the CR grades falls between two grades, the lower grade is taken.

question: Is an NRC needed when a CR is not available?
answer: Yes. When a CR for a year is not available, the Non-Receipt Certificate (NRC) must be uploaded; the CR entry cannot be saved without it.

question: What do the DPC colours mean?
answer: Green: pending with the AO or AH. Blue: with CGPSC. Red: closed.

question: When can the AO mark DPC Proceeding Complete?
answer: Only after the promotion order has been issued. The mark is permanent: after it the DPC is closed and cannot be changed.
variants: How do I close a DPC?

question: Why does approval ask for an OTP?
answer: Legally significant actions such as approving and signing a proposal need a one-time password. It is recorded as your signature.

question: Can I upload officers from a spreadsheet?
answer: Yes. In the section, download the blank template, fill it, choose Upload and Preview, check the errors listed by row, and then Commit.

question: What is Self-Inspection?
answer: An officer under consideration can check their own data before the committee sits, from Self-Inspection on the front page. No account is needed. If the data is wrong, contact your own department.
variants: How can an officer check their own data?

question: Who do I contact for help?
answer: Departmental users: your Department Admin or nodal officer. Commission users: CGPSC administration. Officers under consideration: your own department, which holds your record.

question: e-DPC पोर्टल क्या है?
answer: छत्तीसगढ़ लोक सेवा आयोग का e-DPC पोर्टल विभागीय पदोन्नति समिति (DPC) की पूरी प्रक्रिया ऑनलाइन करता है: विभाग Pre-DPC और DPC प्रस्ताव तैयार करता है, आयोग बैठक करता है, और परिणाम व पदोन्नति सूची डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर से जारी होती है।

question: लॉगिन कैसे करें?
answer: पोर्टल पर Login चुनें। अपना ईमेल, मोबाइल नंबर या कर्मचारी क्रमांक और पासवर्ड डालें। पहली बार अस्थायी पासवर्ड से लॉगिन करने पर पासवर्ड बदलना ज़रूरी है।

question: पासवर्ड भूल गया हूँ, क्या करूँ?
answer: लॉगिन पेज पर Forgot Password चुनें, अपना पंजीकृत ईमेल या मोबाइल नंबर डालें, आए हुए OTP डालें और नया पासवर्ड सेट करें।

question: DPC की प्रक्रिया क्या है?
answer: 1. विभाग एडमिन Pre-DPC बनाकर AO और AH आवंटित करता है। 2. AO Pre-DPC भरकर सबमिट करता है, AH अनुमोदन करता है। 3. AO DPC प्रस्ताव बनाकर सभी सेक्शन पूरे करके सबमिट करता है। 4. AH अनुमोदन, हस्ताक्षर कर CGPSC को भेजता है। 5. CGPSC सदस्य बैठक कर परिणाम अनुमोदित करता है। 6. AH पदोन्नति आदेश जारी करता है। 7. AO DPC Proceeding Complete मार्क करता है।

question: सेवानिवृत्ति तिथि कैसे निकलती है?
answer: यदि जन्म तिथि किसी महीने की 1 तारीख है तो सेवानिवृत्ति पिछले महीने के अंतिम दिन होगी, अन्यथा जन्म के महीने के अंतिम दिन।

question: CR ग्रेड का औसत कैसे लिया जाता है?
answer: जब CR ग्रेडों का औसत दो ग्रेडों के बीच आता है तो नीचे वाला ग्रेड लिया जाता है।

question: CR उपलब्ध न हो तो क्या करें?
answer: जिस वर्ष का CR उपलब्ध नहीं है उसके लिए NRC (Non-Receipt Certificate) अपलोड करना अनिवार्य है; इसके बिना CR प्रविष्टि सेव नहीं होगी।

question: सबमिट करने के बाद प्रस्ताव कैसे सुधारें?
answer: AH प्रस्ताव को सुधार के लिए लौटा सकता है। CGPSC परिणाम आने तक AO, Submitted या Approved DPC को Recall भी कर सकता है: वह Returned हो जाता है, AO सुधार कर दोबारा सबमिट करता है और AH फिर से अनुमोदन करता है।

question: DPC के रंगों का क्या मतलब है?
answer: हरा: AO या AH के पास लंबित। नीला: CGPSC के पास। लाल: बंद (Closed)।
variants: DPC का रंग लाल क्यों है?

question: मुझे Pre-DPC या DPC क्यों नहीं दिख रहा?
answer: Pre-DPC या DPC आपको तभी दिखता है जब विभाग एडमिन ने आपको उसका AO या AH आवंटित किया हो। आवंटन जाँचने के लिए अपने विभाग एडमिन से संपर्क करें।

question: Can I ask something outside DPC?
answer: No. I can answer only questions about the CGPSC e-DPC Portal and the DPC process — login and password, Pre-DPC, DPC proposal, seniority list and Zone of Consideration, vacancy management, CR/NRC and retirement rules, DPC status and colours. For anything else, please contact the concerned office.

answer: नहीं। मैं केवल CGPSC e-DPC पोर्टल और DPC प्रक्रिया से जुड़े प्रश्नों के उत्तर देता हूँ — लॉगिन व पासवर्ड, Pre-DPC, DPC प्रस्ताव, वरिष्ठता सूची, रिक्ति प्रबंधन, CR/NRC व सेवानिवृत्ति नियम, DPC की स्थिति। अन्य विषयों के लिए संबंधित कार्यालय से संपर्क करें।
